name: Gojo
skill: Passive, Infinity: skill damage can't reach Gojo. Basic attacks wear down his Infinity (250 + 60% AP); once broken it returns after 15s. Blue: raises the Blue flag for 2.5s. His next basic attack launches the Blue orb at its target (40 + 40% AP), which collapses the instant it lands into a black hole that yanks nearby enemies to its centre (60 + 80% AP, stronger pull and 100 + 80% AP from level 3). The flag is used up and Blue recharges in 10s. With the Red flag also up, that attack becomes Hollow Purple instead.
skill2: Red: raises the Red flag for 2.5s. His next basic attack fires the Red blast: a fast piercing shot that shoves everything in its path (40 + 50% AP) and explodes at the end of its range, blasting enemies around that spot away (60 + 70% AP). The flag is used up and Red recharges in 8s. Hollow Purple: with both flags up, his next basic attack winds up for 0.57s, then fires a huge, slow orb that crosses the map (260 + 220% AP) and the recoil knocks Gojo back. Both flags are used up and Blue and Red recharge 50% slower for 21s.
ult: Unlimited Void: Gojo stands still while a ring spreads out from him to the domain's edge, then every enemy around him is stunned. The domain stays where it opened. Void Overload also cripples crowd-control-immune champions: they barely move, attack or deal damage, and their cooldowns almost freeze. While it is open, nothing from outside can hurt or crowd-control Gojo. With the native "Gojo domain rules" mod: his closest teammate inside stays free and protected, every other teammate inside is stunned, crowd-control immunity is ignored, and nobody can get in until it closes. Slow cast while Infinity is up, fast cast when it is broken. Slow: 2.5s cast, stuns for 4s, then +40% damage, +10% move speed, +10% attack speed for 10s. Fast: 0.75s cast, stuns for 2s, then +15% damage, +35% move speed, +35% attack speed for 10s. Cooldown 60s.
